title: The Man from Platform 4

setting.summary: Vesper Central Station and The Grand Vesper Hotel on a cold November evening.

briefing: At 22:00, the Transit Cipher Ledger vanished from Vesper Central Station during an encrypted courier relay. Intelligence warns that the operative 'The Chameleon' arrived under a false identity to intercept it. Who is the impostor, and how was their alibi broken?

characters.name: Irene Frost
characters.publicDescription: Foreign affairs attache lodging at the Grand Vesper Hotel while delivering encrypted transit manifests.

characters.name: Julian Croft
characters.publicDescription: Night supervisor in charge of freight staging and luggage locker dispatch at Vesper Central Station.

characters.name: Kendra Pike
characters.publicDescription: Maintenance technician monitoring rail power systems and concourse turnstiles.

characters.name: Lucas Mercer
characters.publicDescription: Traveling archivist claiming to be in Vesper City for an auction, staying at the Grand Vesper Hotel.

locations.name: Vesper Central Station
locations.description: Subterranean rail terminus featuring passenger platforms, automated luggage bays, and staff offices.

locations.name: The Grand Vesper Hotel
locations.description: Neoclassical luxury hotel situated three kilometers north of the central rail terminus.

objects.name: The Transit Cipher Ledger
objects.description: An encrypted dispatch journal bound in dark morocco leather containing railway junction codes.

clues.text: Irene stated: 'I remained in my suite at the Grand Vesper Hotel from 21:15 to 21:35 reviewing conference papers.'
Julian stated: 'I was on duty inside the station freight office from 21:20 to 21:40 logging overnight cargo manifests.'
Lucas stated: 'I was in the Grand Vesper Hotel lobby from 21:20 to 21:40 having tea before turning in.'
Hotel safe deposit dispatch receipt: Irene Frost held registered custody of the Transit Cipher Ledger until courier transfer from 21:05 to 21:20.
Station concourse gate reader: Technician Kendra Pike scanned service pass at Concourse Gate at 21:10.
Hotel suite electronic lock record: Irene Frost unlocked Suite 402 at Grand Vesper Hotel at 21:25.
Automated luggage locker telemetry: Julian Croft placed the Transit Cipher Ledger into locker storage at 21:25.
Station platform camera feed: Lucas Mercer recorded on Platform 4 at Vesper Central Station from 21:45 to 21:55.

hypotheses.label: Irene Frost used an attache alias to take the ledger during a secret meet at the station.
Julian Croft retained custody of the cipher ledger to sell to foreign syndicates.
Lucas Mercer is 'The Chameleon' who retrieved the ledger at Vesper Central Station.

explanation.text: Irene Frost unlocked Suite 402 at the Grand Vesper Hotel at 21:25, disproving claims that she slipped away to the train station.
Hotel safe records prove Irene held custody of the ledger until 21:20, disproving that Julian Croft stole it during early dispatch.
Lucas Mercer appeared on Platform 4 security cameras at 21:45, an impossible 5-minute transit from his claimed 21:40 hotel alibi.
Lucas Mercer retrieved the Transit Cipher Ledger from locker storage at 21:48, confirming his identity as 'The Chameleon'.
